name: rank_candidate_drug_compounds
description: Use this tool to rank candidate drug compounds based on their predicted binding affinity, toxicity risk, and blood-brain barrier penetration score. Do not use this tool if you only need to evaluate a single compound or if you require detailed molecular dynamics simulations, as this tool focuses on ranking rather than detailed analysis.

parameters.name: binding_affinities
parameters.description: An array of predicted binding affinity values for the candidate compounds, measured in nanomolar (nM). Each value should be a positive number.

parameters.name: toxicity_risks
parameters.description: An array of toxicity risk scores for the candidate compounds, where each score is a number between 0 (no risk) and 1 (high risk).

parameters.name: bb_penetration_scores
parameters.description: An array of blood-brain barrier penetration scores for the candidate compounds, where each score is a number between 0 (no penetration) and 1 (high penetration).

ranked_compounds.description: An array of objects representing the ranked candidate compounds.

compound_id.description: A unique identifier for the compound.

rank.description: The rank of the compound in the list, starting from 1 for the highest-ranked compound.

binding_affinity.description: The predicted binding affinity of the compound in nanomolar (nM).

toxicity_risk.description: The toxicity risk score of the compound, between 0 and 1.

bb_penetration_score.description: The blood-brain barrier penetration score of the compound, between 0 and 1.

return_schema.description: A ranked list of candidate drug compounds based on the provided scores.
